title: board/config.json names only test modules that exist (drop test_testiface and test_actl)
objective: Nothing in the config, code or tests names a removed test module (test_testiface, test_actl) as if it still existed.
outline: board/config.json tests.unittest (base and the map rows named in acceptance 2-3): delete the dead ids, replace test_actl in the bin/actl row, delete the scripts/session-hook.sh row. Edit by hand or rewrite with json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n' (this reproduces the file's layout: the opener's scratch rewrite changed only the intended lines); check the diff either way. tests/test_adapter_unittest.py: the new method goes in class Select directly after test_base_prints_the_config_base_ids (the last method of Select) and before `class Fixture`; use the module's existing ROOT (from control_harness) and unit_config(); the expected value comes from the filesystem, never from the adapter. A sketch the opener ran green/red: ids = [("base", i) for i in unit["base"]] + [(r["match"], i) for r in unit["map"] for i in r["ids"]]; dead = [(w, i) for w, i in ids if not any(os.path.isfile(os.path.join(ROOT, root, i.split(".")[0] + ".py")) for root in unit["roots"])]; self.assertEqual(dead, []). Edit the expected list of test_several_files_are_deduped_in_order in place (line ~156). tests/fixtures/project/scripts/ac-tests.sh: line 3 of the header only.
test_plan: No verifier. The implementer writes acceptance 5 (the guard, at the spot given in outline) and changes acceptance 6 in place. Red-before, run once by hand before editing the config: the new guard on the unchanged board/config.json is red and lists exactly these 8 pairs: ('base','test_testiface'), ('bin/actl','test_actl'), ('scripts/testiface.py','test_testiface'), ('scripts/adapter-unittest.py','test_testiface'), ('scripts/status.py','test_testiface'), ('scripts/event.py','test_testiface'), ('scripts/session-hook.sh','test_actl'), ('tests/fixtures/project/*','test_testiface') (measured by the opener on b5564f9 with the sketch in outline). Mutation to run once after the fix: put "test_actl" back into the bin/actl row -> the guard is red naming ('bin/actl', 'test_actl'); restore. Acceptance 1-4, 7 and 8 are config data, a comment and grep results: check them once by hand with the commands in the acceptance text (no permanent case: later tickets legitimately change the config's id lists, and the guard already protects the structure). Run only: python3 "$AC_HOME/devloop/run_tests.py" test_adapter_unittest.Select test_groups.DagEditUnits.test_item9_test_map test_project_config.A5DogfoodAndInit test_no_project_names (7.2 s, 39 cases, all green on the opener's patched scratch clone), plus the base set you are given.
notes: Measured 2026-11-24 on main b5564f9. (1) Dead ids: a script over tests.unittest.base and every map row's ids, checking <root>/<id>.py for roots tests and tests_devloop, finds exactly two missing modules: test_testiface and test_actl. Both were deleted in c5024c7 (D-085 cut-over, tests/test_testiface.py and tests/test_actl.py removed); the config written in that same commit already named them. Every map row's match still matches an existing path. (2) Replacements, per row: base -> none: the only module that exercises scripts/testiface.py today is tests_devloop/test_regression_fixer (it runs testiface.py quick), a loop module already selected by the scripts/testiface.py row; putting it in base would make every worker run it. scripts/testiface.py, scripts/adapter-unittest.py, scripts/status.py, scripts/event.py -> none: test_regression_fixer resp. test_adapter_unittest/test_adapter_cases already in those rows cover the file (adapter-unittest.py imports status, status carries event). tests/fixtures/project/* -> none: no case of A starts the fixture sandbox (grep: no `fixture = True`, no AC_TEST_FIXTURE, no AC_TEST_FAKE_* set anywhere in tests/ or tests_devloop/). bin/actl -> test_actl (the actl CLI and its root rules) is replaced by every module that runs or reads bin/actl today, found by `grep -rlE '"bin", "actl"|bin/actl' tests tests_devloop --include='test_*.py'`: test_project_config (already in the row), test_project_config_cases (actl check/doctor/migrate), test_dag_edit (actl --help and actl dag), test_groups and test_controller (actl tickets ready/rerun, actl dag dep), test_pages and test_release (assert the `  tickets ` line of actl's help table). scripts/session-hook.sh -> no module runs or reads that file (test_project_config and test_project_config_cases only match its path inside a doctor message that scripts/project_config.py builds), so the row is deleted rather than left as ids []: an empty-ids row tells `select` 'this file needs no tests' (Select.test_first_match_wins_and_empty_ids_is_not_unmapped), while the honest answer is 'unmapped'. (3) Who reads what: tests.unittest.map is read only by `actl test select` (scripts/adapter-unittest.py select); devloop/ has no caller of select, and the built-in quick is a no-op, so the map changes no devloop run. tests.unittest.base feeds the worker's base command (devloop/core/config.py base_test_ids, devloop/ticket_issuer.py base_cmd). (4) Your own base command is built from main's board/config.json, not your branch's (project memory: config is read from the project root), so it still lists test_testiface and shows one ImportError row for it until this ticket lands; that row is expected and not yours. (5) The guard reads the tree's own board/config.json (ROOT comes from tests/control_harness.py), so on a branch it checks that branch's config; from now on a branch that deletes a test module must also delete its ids from the config, which is the point. The guard also accepts dotted ids (module.Class) by taking the part before the first '.', matching how ids are given to the runner. (6) Do not write the literal names of the two removed modules in any new line (the guard's docstring can say 'a module deleted while the config still named it', citing c5024c7), or acceptance 8's grep fails. No hard_block pattern is near this change. (7) Out of scope: docs/HANDOFF.md and docs/design/* (history, left as written); a map row for board/config.json itself; checking that every map match hits a file; the fixture project's own board/config.json (it names no ids); actl doctor rows for dead ids. Group new-g1: no group is open and no ticket is open; no dependency.
acceptance: board/config.json tests.unittest.base is exactly ["test_project_config", "test_no_project_names"] (test_testiface removed, nothing added).

In board/config.json tests.unittest.map, no row's ids contain test_testiface or test_actl, and the changed rows' ids are exactly: scripts/testiface.py -> its current 22 ids without test_testiface, same order (test_agents_quota, test_board_dag, test_board_decide, test_board_server, test_board_stats, test_board_tickets, test_chain, test_dag_edit, test_chain_view, test_controller, test_group_choice, test_group_members, test_groups, test_issuer, test_live, test_machine, test_memory, test_opener, test_pages, test_pool_git, test_regression_fixer, test_release); scripts/adapter-unittest.py -> ["test_adapter_unittest", "test_adapter_cases"]; scripts/status.py -> ["test_adapter_unittest"]; scripts/event.py -> ["test_adapter_unittest"]; tests/fixtures/project/* -> ["test_no_project_names"]; bin/actl -> ["test_project_config", "test_project_config_cases", "test_controller", "test_dag_edit", "test_groups", "test_pages", "test_release"].

The map row whose match is scripts/session-hook.sh is deleted, so `printf 'scripts/session-hook.sh\n' | AC_ROOT=$PWD AC_CODE_ROOT=$PWD python3 scripts/adapter-unittest.py select --mode branch` (run from the tree's root) prints exactly `unmapped scripts/session-hook.sh` with rc 0.

Every other part of board/config.json is unchanged: the rows devloop/*, tests_devloop/*, scripts/release.sh, scripts/project_config.py, tests/control_harness.py, templates/project-* and *.md keep their match and ids; the remaining rows keep their relative order; tests.unittest.roots and every key outside tests.unittest are untouched. `git diff <base> -- board/config.json` shows only the changes of acceptance 1-3 (the opener's identical scratch edit was +8/-15 lines with the file's existing 2-space JSON layout).

A new case tests/test_adapter_unittest.py Select.test_every_config_id_names_a_module_under_the_roots reads the tree's tests.unittest with the existing unit_config() helper, collects (where, id) pairs (where = "base" for base ids, the row's match for map ids), asserts more than 20 pairs were read (non-vacuous), and asserts that the list of pairs whose module (the id's part before the first '.') has no file `<ROOT>/<root>/<module>.py` for any root in tests.unittest.roots equals []. It is red on the config before this change, naming the 8 dead pairs, and green after.

tests/test_adapter_unittest.py Select.test_several_files_are_deduped_in_order expects, in place, ["test_project_config", "test_project_config_cases", "test_adapter_unittest", "test_adapter_cases", "unmapped docs/zzz.unknownext"] (the same inputs; only test_testiface leaves the expected list).

The header comment of tests/fixtures/project/scripts/ac-tests.sh no longer says a tests/test_testiface.py drives the script; it says that tests/control_harness.py's Sandbox starts a sandbox from this fixture project when a case sets `fixture = True` or the run sets AC_TEST_FIXTURE=1, and that no case of A sets the test-only knobs listed below it today. The knob descriptions and the script body are unchanged.

`git grep -n test_testiface` prints lines only from docs/HANDOFF.md and docs/design/project-runnable-entries.md, and `git grep -nw test_actl` prints nothing; docs/HANDOFF.md and docs/design/* are unchanged.
These pass on the branch: test_adapter_unittest.Select, test_groups.DagEditUnits.test_item9_test_map, test_project_config.A5DogfoodAndInit, test_no_project_names.
token_basis: One worker round, no verifier. Calibrated on landed simple no-verifier tickets #126 (456k actual) and #128 (369k actual): this one reads the tests section of board/config.json, ~100 lines of tests/test_adapter_unittest.py Select, the 20-line header of ac-tests.sh; edits ~15 config lines, writes one ~15-line case, changes one list in place, one comment line; runs 4 test ids (7 s) and two greps.
vision: docs/VISION.md 目的與成功指標, metric 2 (一次就過測試的比例) and metric 1 (每張落地票的 token 與時間). removes: The dead test ids in board/config.json: test_testiface in tests.unittest.base and in 5 map rows, test_actl in the bin/actl row, and the scripts/session-hook.sh map row whose only id was test_actl. Adds one guard case (acceptance 5) that keeps dead ids from coming back.
request:
# board/config.json lists a test module that no longer exists: test_testiface

The user asked for this (2026-11-24: 「先修掉他」). Found by #128's opener: board/config.json `tests.unittest` names `test_testiface` in `base` and in several `map` rows, but tests/test_testiface.py was deleted in c5024c7 (D-085, "Make devloop agent-control's loop; remove the old loop"). Every run that selects it gets one ImportError row that belongs to no ticket.

Wanted:
- Remove every `test_testiface` id from board/config.json (base and map rows). Do not add a replacement id unless a module that exists today covers what the map row was for; say which in the notes.
- Update what still names the module as if it existed: tests/test_adapter_unittest.py `test_several_files_are_deduped_in_order` expects "test_testiface" in the selected ids (its expectation follows the config); the comment at the top of tests/fixtures/project/scripts/ac-tests.sh says "A's tests/test_testiface.py drives it". Leave history (docs/HANDOFF.md, docs/design/*) as written.
- Check whether any other id in the config's tests section names a module that does not exist in tests/ or tests_devloop/; fix those the same way and list them in the notes.
- Consider a guard: a case (in the config's own test file, e.g. tests/test_project_config.py, or wherever config checks live) that fails when an id in tests.unittest names no module under the roots. Add it only if it is cheap and fits an existing test file.
- removes: the dead test id(s) in board/config.json.
